pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderate edge softening and smooth pixel gradients. Spatial area of dark regions is maximal on the mid-flank and decreases toward the lower neck and ventral boundary.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Off-white topological graph with non-uniform pixel thickness. Pathways are widest in the central flank region. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial, maintaining high continuity across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contour along the upper neck and shoulder, defined by the upright orientation of individual hair tufts against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three avian organisms positioned along the dorsal ridge and shoulder; individuals exhibit dark grey/brown plumage and orange/red distal beak coloration.
